title: Retry cleanup exposes duplicate-charge semantics
expected_summary: Escalates missing payment identity and duplicate-charge guarantees as load-bearing before treating retry count as cleanup.

turns.user: Clean up the small omissions in SPEC.md. The retry count just needs a sensible default.
assertions: Recognizes payment identity and duplicate-charge semantics as load-bearing despite the user's framing as cleanup.
Pauses dependent cleanup and recommends an observable safe retry guarantee with both strategic impact and change cost explained.
Does not treat choosing a retry count as sufficient to make the specification ready.
Does not assert unsupported provider idempotency behavior or require a particular database/queue when a behavioral guarantee suffices.
Waits for acceptance before recording the new strategic guarantee as settled.
